description: Convert between FASTA and GenBank (whole sequence, CDS or protein), or export to TSV.

from.description: Input format; 'auto' sniffs it from the first meaningful line.

input.description: A FASTA or GenBank record to convert.

to.description: Output format. fasta-cds / fasta-protein extract CDS features (GenBank input only). GenBank in and 'genbank' out rewrites the record with its features, qualifiers and topology intact — it is a rewrite, not a re-annotation. 'snapgene' writes a binary SnapGene .dna file, returned base64 in `fileBase64` rather than in `output`; it takes ONE record, because a .dna holds one molecule.

name: sequence_format_convert
title: Sequence Format Converter
